ref.locator: famiwal.be 'Résumé des montants' (Dernière modification: 10/09/2026), section 'Allocations familiales de base', table 'Enfants nés à partir du 1er janvier 2020', row '0-17 ans'; same figure on 'Vos allocations familiales de base' (Dernière modification: 08/09/2026)
ref.quote: Enfants nés à partir du 1er janvier 2020 | Enfant | € | 0-17 ans | 200,51 € | De 18 à 24 ans | 213,44 €
ref.note: 200.51 €/month × 12 = 2,406.12 €/year Monthly amount as displayed on 2026-10-20 (page 'Dernière modification: 10/09/2026'); the page does not state from which month it applies, so it reflects the indexation in force in autumn 2026 (earlier in 2026 the amount was lower). Basic amount only: excludes the yearly age supplement (prime scolaire), social supplements, orphan and disability supplements, which the budget line also pays. Children born before 2020 stay in the old system (rank-based: 123.94 / 229.32 / 342.39 €/month for 1st / 2nd / 3rd+ child per the same table), and 18-24-year-olds get 213.44 €/month, so this is not the average cost per child. FAMIWAL is one of the payment funds; the amounts are set by Walloon law and are the same at every fund. Checked by a second agent: Re-downloaded both FAMIWAL pages on 2026-10-20: 200,51 € (0-17, born from 1 Jan 2020) and 213,44 € (18-24) found verbatim; Résumé page last modified 10/09/2026, base page 08/09/2026. Arithmetic 200.51 × 12 = 2,406.12 checks. Value confirmed; label corrected because 'one (Walloon) child' overstates the scope: children born before 2020 stay on the old rank-based scale (123,94 / 229,32 / 342,39 €), and the amount excludes the age, social, single-parent, orphan and disability supplements that the same budget line pays. All children born from 2020 are under 18 in 2026, so the 0-17 rate applies to every one of them. 'Waals kind' replaced by 'kind in Wallonië' (entitlement follows residence, not nationality). The page does not state since when 200,51 € applies; it is +2% on the earlier 196,57 € (consistent with a September 2026 indexation), so a year at this rate is the rate in force in autumn 2026, not the 2026 calendar-year average. FAMIWAL is a public fund; amounts are set by Walloon law and identical at all funds. The dotation line (AVIQ family branch) does pay this benefit.
